notes.title: Resident Evil -- Release date, price, and gorgeous 60fps PC footage revealed
notes.notes:
[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_d27983bb8176325d81cf0ca83dfb30ec247e6f23.jpg]

All aboard the hype train for Resident Evil! The enhanced version of the classic 2002 "REmake" officially hits digital outlets starting January 20. Beginning on that day, you'll be able to pick it up for $19.99/€19.99/£15.99 on PS4, PS3, Xbox 360, Xbox One and PC.

While it's nice to finally know the price and release date, nothing speaks louder than gameplay footage. So to that end, take a peep at this lovely 60fps gameplay footage taken directly from the PC version of the game. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3a6-6QWyLGY&list=UUS2iGSouOopNHXFBcWtBQiA Note: Make sure to set the YouTube setting to either "1080p/60" or "720p/60."  Browsers currently known to support 60fps stream are IE11 (64-bit version) and Chrome.


We also have a bevy of new PC screenshots to consider as well - check 'em out!  (visit the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/304240/]Resident Evil store page[/url] for 1080p versions)

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_d75906451d3a57bb8fc65fdea7ce09fbf1d3b726.jpg?t=1417762193]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_8ff9a328bbfa668034356554ceb3d29a7dc7262f.jpg?t=1417762193]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_2ad5847f8eb39c09187dfafc240bfd821d50a8ba.jpg?t=1417762193]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_a7885d2ba6ca01343d4b58bfe10b74efabaa7eb7.jpg?t=1417762193]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_ea73c8a2900d3954fac684104167a6a1eb778026.jpg?t=1417762193]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_063bf03851cd3e8bc9746fb4735e1aed2c3843c2.jpg?t=1417762193]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/304240/ss_f962f2ae74d759e6b99c6e7627e36a630a086abd.jpg?t=1417762193][i](Shout-out to Moira!)[/i]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1crgIxdlpqs And then on top of all that, we've also put together this fun salute to the 200+ doors of the Spencer Mansion and its surrounding areas. No fancy angle here, just doors upon doors upon doors - strange how something so simple can still take you back.

Game's out starting from January 20!
